changes: signature of `prism.cli.brief` is now `brief(root: RootOption = None, full: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--full', help='The whole AGENTS.md, not the compact session brief.')] = False, as_json: JsonOption = False) -> None`
signature of `prism.cli.hook_session_start` is now `hook_session_start(fmt: FormatOption = 'text', event: EventOption = None) -> None`

signature of `prism.cli.init` is now `init(root: RootOption = None, agent: Annotated[str, typer.Option('--agent', help='claude-code | cursor | codex | gemini | antigravity | generic | auto | none')] = 'auto', hooks: Annotated[bool | None, typer.Option('--hooks/--no-hooks', help='Agent hooks.')] = None, mcp: Annotated[bool | None, typer.Option('--mcp/--no-mcp', help='Register the MCP server.')] = None, git_hooks: Annotated[bool | None, typer.Option('--git-hooks/--no-git-hooks', help='Git post-commit/merge/checkout hooks.')] = None, yes: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--yes', '-y', help='Skip prompts (scripted use).')] = False, run_scan: Annotated[bool | None, typer.Option('--scan/--no-scan', help='Run the initial scan without asking.')] = None) -> None`

signature of `prism.cli.mcp_cmd` is now `mcp_cmd(root: RootOption = None, profile: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option('--profile', help='lean (default: task, context, impact, status) or full (adds search, audit, ...).')] = None) -> None`

signature of `prism.cli.update_cmd` is now `update_cmd(paths: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Argument(help='Files known to have changed (same as --files; any number).')] = None, files: Annotated[list[str] | None, typer.Option('--files', help='A file known to have changed. Repeatable; extra paths work.')] = None, root: RootOption = None, quiet: QuietOption = False, as_json: JsonOption = False) -> None`

signature of `prism.lifecycle.run_index` is now `run_index(root: Path, *, incremental: bool, files: list[str] | None = None, full: bool = False, lazy_rank: bool = True, lock_wait: float = 10.0) -> IndexRun`
signature of `prism.lifecycle.scan` is now `scan(root: Path, full: bool = False, warm: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]`
signature of `prism.lifecycle.update` is now `update(root: Path, files: list[str] | None = None, lazy_rank: bool = True, lock_wait: float = 10.0) -> IndexRun`

signature of `prism.cli.task` is now `task(query: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(help='The request, a symbol name, or a file path.')], root: RootOption = None, budget: Annotated[int, typer.Option('--budget', min=128, max=32000)] = 2000, mode: Annotated[str, typer.Option('--mode', help='auto | overview (signatures/map) | code (edit context)')] = 'auto', session: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option('--session', help='Remember returned code in this session; repeats become one-line references.')] = None, as_json: JsonOption = False) -> None`
signature of `prism.discovery.scanner.discover` is now `discover(root: Path, config: PrismConfig, known: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None, resniff: bool = True) -> list[SourceFile]`
signature of `prism.hooks.runner.post_edit` is now `post_edit(raw_stdin: str, background: bool = False) -> None`
signature of `prism.mcp.server.PrismTools.prism_brief` is now `prism_brief(self, full: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]`
signature of `prism.mcp.server.build_server` is now `build_server(root: Path, profile: str | None = None) -> Any`
signature of `prism.mcp.server.enabled_tools` is now `enabled_tools(root: Path, profile: str | None = None) -> list[str]`
signature of `prism.mcp.server.run` is now `run(root: Path, profile: str | None = None) -> None`
signature of `prism.mcp.server.PrismTools.prism_task` is now `prism_task(self, query: str, budget: int = 2000, repeat: bool = False, mode: str = 'auto') -> dict[str, Any]`
signature of `prism.navigator.api.op_brief` is now `op_brief(root: Path, full: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]`
signature of `prism.navigator.api.op_task` is now `op_task(store: IndexStore, query: str, budget: int = 2000, seen: set[tuple[str, int, int]] | None = None, mode: str = 'auto') -> dict[str, Any]`
signature of `prism.navigator.session.load_seen` is now `load_seen(root: Path, session: str, manifest: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> set[Range]`
signature of `prism.navigator.session.save_seen` is now `save_seen(root: Path, session: str, seen: set[Range], manifest: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None`

signature of `prism.navigator.task_pack.build_task` is now `build_task(store: IndexStore, query: str, budget: int = 2000, seen: set[tuple[str, int, int]] | None = None, mode: str = 'auto') -> dict[str, Any]`
